I replied in the thread on your 9:00 message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. That post said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has nothing else on the guard's activity. The next guard reference is Mateo's 11:03 AM post: kiosk 1 was back, and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. The channel doesn't say when that check-in happened. Your 11:08 AM post says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
